title: The Warrens
description: An ancient network of aqueducts and cisterns beneath the estate, older than the manor above, broken into during the Ancestor's excavations and used thereafter as a dump for the misshapen leavings of his rituals. The swinefolk that took root there have made it their own, building, butchering, and worshipping in the dark. Travel is stooped and wet—cramped brick vaulting, red mire underfoot, air thick with rot, and distant squealing down every duct.
summary: An ancient aqueduct network beneath the estate, once a dump for the Ancestor's ritual leavings, now the burrow-city of the swinefolk.

title: The Spoiled Meat
description: A broken stretch of tunnel opening onto a wide waste of bone and mud under a sickly haze. Carcass-cuts hang from chained hooks overhead, long past eating, and skulls lie heaped along the fallen timbers.
summary: A broken tunnel mouth hung with rotting meat on hooks, opening onto a bone-strewn waste.

title: The Great Duct
description: The mouth of a major duct, its grate half-eaten by rust and dripping with orange filth. Red sludge pours steadily from it and spreads across the chamber floor, ankle-deep in places.
summary: A huge rusted duct-mouth steadily disgorging red sludge across the chamber floor.

title: The Old Gallery
description: A colonnaded gallery of finer masonry than the tunnels around it, with a brazier burning on the ledge beside a cluster of melted candles. Skulls are stacked neatly against a rotten log; someone tends the flames.
summary: A finer colonnaded gallery with a tended brazier, melted candles, and neatly stacked skulls.

title: The Effigy
description: A towering effigy fills the chamber: an iron crown turned upside down, six-spoked, built enormous from stone slabs and stretched hide. Many swinefolk wear its likeness. A burning brazier stands at either side, kept lit.
summary: A towering swinefolk effigy of an inverted, six-spoked iron crown, flanked by tended braziers.

title: The Flesh Seeps
description: A chamber where red sinew has grown up through the brickwork, spreading over benches and arches in ropy sheets. On the far wall the growth has bunched into the crude likeness of a horned, grinning face.
summary: A chamber overgrown with red sinew that has bunched into the likeness of a horned, grinning face.

title: The Hovels
description: A cluster of swine dwellings raised inside a larger chamber—tents of stitched hide over timber stakes, fenced with scavenged planks. Yellow smoke hangs low over the mud between them.
summary: A cluster of swinefolk hide-tents and plank fences under low-hanging smoke.

title: The Grate
description: A wall of heavy iron bars closes the tunnel from floor to ceiling, the passage beyond it choked with fallen stone. The bars are old work, and whatever they were set to hold back, the rubble now holds better.
summary: A floor-to-ceiling iron grate sealing a tunnel already choked with fallen stone.

title: The Meat Locker
description: A chamber strung with chains and hooks, hung densely with cuts of meat in every state of freshness. Skulls and stripped bones are heaped where they fell beneath the hooks.
summary: A chain-strung larder hung with meat in every state of freshness, bones heaped below.

title: The Crossways
description: A junction where arched passages recede in every direction, identical brick swallowing the torchlight. Down one of them, far off, a cluster of candles burns on a ledge.
summary: A junction of identical receding brick archways, distant candlelight down one passage.

title: The Shrine
description: A ledge crowded with burning candles and braziers beneath two hanging banners—one daubed with a tusked jaw, the other with rows of runes. A standard pole leans against the stonework, wrapped in cord.
summary: A candle-crowded swinefolk shrine beneath banners daubed with a tusked jaw and runes.

title: The Tannery
description: Two hides stretched taut on timber frames stand mid-chamber, a brazier burning beside them and empty hooks swaying overhead. Runes are daubed on the wall behind in something dark.
summary: A skin-stretching room of taut hides on frames, a lit brazier, and dark-daubed runes.

title: The Sluice
description: A wide, low hall where several barred culvert-mouths open at floor level, bones and skulls spilling from them into the red mire. Whatever the sluices once carried, they carry remains now.
summary: A low hall of barred culvert-mouths spilling bones and skulls into the red mire.

title: The Diggings
description: A working face where the swine are tunneling upward—ladders lashed to the walls, a cart heaped with spoil, picks and shovels left mid-shift. Through a barred opening, lamplit buildings show in the gloom beyond.
summary: An active swine digging with ladders, carts, and tools, its barred opening showing lamplit buildings beyond.

title: The Dumping Ground
description: Three great duct-arches stand choked with fused red flesh, egg-like sacs budding on stalks along the walls. Here the Ancestor disposed of his failed summonings, the half-living offal heaped until it grew together; a heart-like mass sits in the central arch, and it moves.
summary: The duct-arches where the Ancestor's ritual offal was heaped until it fused into a single living mass.

title: The Feeding Hall
description: A court of bone and hide: a huge crowned seat of tusks and skulls, a butcher's block heaped with gore beneath an embedded cleaver, braziers and rune-banners on every side. Here the swine feed the great brute the Ancestor summoned and abandoned, as they have fed it since he emptied a village to do so.
summary: The bone-and-hide court where the swinefolk feed the great brute the Ancestor summoned and abandoned.

title: The Ossuary
description: Arched wall-niches packed with stacked skulls, red root-flesh grown through the gaps between them. Two pillars carved with runes give off a dull orange glow, and a flanged mace hangs on its chain beside the eastern arch.
summary: Wall-niches packed with skulls amid red root-flesh, lit by two dully glowing rune pillars.

title: The Gatehouse
description: A two-story structure of newer brick straddling a culvert arch, its upper window hung with a pale cloth. The floor before it is stained a deep, walked-in red, and half its planking has been torn away for timber.
summary: A ruined two-story brick gatehouse over a culvert arch, its floor stained a walked-in red.
